  option = {
    name = skonester_cheat_menu.res.plus_5000
    trigger = {
      skonester_edit_resources_menu_enabled_trigger = yes
    }
    skonester_cheat_menu_recipient_add_gold_effect = { AMOUNT = 5000 }
    scope:actor = {
      trigger_event = skonester_cheat_menu.3051
    }
  }
  option = {
    name = skonester_cheat_menu.res.plus_10000
    trigger = {
      skonester_edit_resources_menu_enabled_trigger = yes
    }
    skonester_cheat_menu_recipient_add_gold_effect = { AMOUNT = 10000 }
    scope:actor = {
      trigger_event = skonester_cheat_menu.3051
    }
  }
  option = {
    name = skonester_cheat_menu.res.minus_5000
    trigger = {
      skonester_edit_resources_menu_enabled_trigger = yes
      skonester_edit_resources_recipient_gold_at_least_trigger = { MIN = 5000 }
    }
    show_as_tooltip = {
      skonester_cheat_menu_edit_resources_sync_recipient_effect = yes
      if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target }
        scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target = { remove_short_term_gold = 5000 }
      }
      else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = skonester_cheat_menu_recipient }
        global_var:skonester_cheat_menu_recipient = { remove_short_term_gold = 5000 }
      }
      else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
        scope:recipient = { remove_short_term_gold = 5000 }
      }
    }
    skonester_cheat_menu_recipient_remove_gold_effect = { AMOUNT = 5000 }
    scope:actor = {
      trigger_event = skonester_cheat_menu.3051
    }
  }
  option = {
    name = skonester_cheat_menu.res.minus_10000
    trigger = {
      skonester_edit_resources_menu_enabled_trigger = yes
      skonester_edit_resources_recipient_gold_at_least_trigger = { MIN = 10000 }
    }
    show_as_tooltip = {
      skonester_cheat_menu_edit_resources_sync_recipient_effect = yes
      if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target }
        scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target = { remove_short_term_gold = 10000 }
      }
      else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = skonester_cheat_menu_recipient }
        global_var:skonester_cheat_menu_recipient = { remove_short_term_gold = 10000 }
      }
      else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
        scope:recipient = { remove_short_term_gold = 10000 }
      }
    }
    skonester_cheat_menu_recipient_remove_gold_effect = { AMOUNT = 10000 }
    scope:actor = {
      trigger_event = skonester_cheat_menu.3051
    }
  }
  option = {
